slides.headline: Avoid Costly Reworks in US SaaS Automation
slides.body: Many US SaaS founders rush into custom AI automation without proper groundwork, leading to project delays and overspending. A structured pre-build checklist ensures your solution aligns perfectly with business goals and goes live faster.

slides.headline: Validate API Access & Docs First
slides.body: Before any code is written, confirm robust API access for your critical tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, or Intercom. Ensure current documentation exists for all webhooks and authentication methods.

slides.headline: Map Out Data Flows & Logic
slides.body: Clearly define every piece of data that moves between systems (e.g., from DocuSign to PostgreSQL). Detail the exact business logic for processing and decision-making, including all edge cases.

slides.headline: Define Clear Success Metrics
slides.body: Quantify your automation's success. Is it saving 15 hours per SDR per week, or boosting demo-to-close rates by 10%? Lock in measurable outcomes to track ROI from day one.
bullets: Percentage lift in key metrics (e.g., conversion)

slides.headline: Plan for Audit Trails & Security
slides.body: For US SaaS, SOC 2 compliance demands transparent logging. Design how every automated action, from Slack channel creation to tenant provisioning, will be recorded for security and audit purposes.
